title: VEP-AI-V1 Verification Receipt Schema
description: Schema for verifier-side verification receipts generated by independent AI verifiers and static auditors evaluating the DROS-VEP repository under protocol VEP-AI-V1.

verification_protocol.description: Standard identifier of the verification protocol.

target_commit_sha.description: The exact 40-character hexadecimal Git commit hash pinned during audit.

branch_name.description: Git branch checked out by the verifier.

commit_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the target commit.

verification_timestamp_utc.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the verification was performed.

clone_verified.description: True if the repository was cloned locally rather than inspected via web scraping.

tracked_file_inventory_verified.description: True if git ls-files was executed to inventory repository contents.

primary_reports_inspected.description: True if primary markdown evaluation reports were inspected.

raw_evidence_inspected.description: True if raw json/csv/pcap evidence was inspected for empirical claims.

readme_only_verification.description: Must be false for any valid VEP-AI-V1 verification receipt.

verification_status.description: Overall status of the verification execution.

verification_scope.description: Declared verification scope: FULL_REPOSITORY or CLAIM_SET.

claims.description: List of Claim IDs evaluated when verification_scope is CLAIM_SET.

claim_verdicts.description: Map of Claim ID to auditor-assigned verdict.

limitations.description: List of declared verification boundaries or limitations.

evidence_chain_incomplete.description: List of Claim IDs where the four-tier evidence chain could not be resolved.
